reference.title: Dumbbell Incline Shrug
reference.listing: Page not read (gymvisual.com is blocked by the proxy); movement taken from the exercise name and standard coaching practice.
reference.note: Reference used only to identify the movement. No GymVisual media is stored here; this rig, model and animation are original.

breathing.pattern: Breathe out as you shrug, breathe in as the shoulders lower.
breathing.cadence: About 1 s up, 1 s squeeze, about 2 s down

prescription.load: User-chosen dumbbells; moderate, the grip often limits
prescription.progression: Add reps and a longer squeeze, then weight

cues.text: Set the bench to about 40 degrees. Straddle the seat with the chest on the pad, balls of the feet on the floor behind; arms hang straight outside the pad, palms in.
Breathe out and lift the shoulders straight up toward the ears; the arms stay long.
Hold the top for a moment; chest stays on the pad, chin neutral.
Breathe in and let the shoulders sink slowly back down to a full stretch.
Pause with the arms hanging, then repeat.

mistakes.fix: Shrug straight up along the trunk and straight back down.
Keep the arms long; only the shoulders move.

mistakes.mistake: Lifting the chest off the pad
mistakes.fix: Keep the chest heavy on the pad.
Pause at the top and lower all the way.

kinematics.norm: Shoulders lift straight up along the trunk; a shrug with the arms raised (30 degrees abduction) raised upper trapezius activity (Pizzari 2014)
About 40 degrees, chest on the pad (clinical opinion)
Pause at the top, slow lowering (clinical opinion)

sources.title: GymVisual #1369, Dumbbell Incline Shrug, video (movement reference only; page not read)

cautions: Stop if sharp pain, a pinching feeling in the front or top of the shoulder, numbness or tingling occurs.
The dumbbell load is user-chosen: pick a weight you can control for every rep with good form.
Muscle glow colours and activation curves are illustrative, not measured EMG.
Stop if the shrug causes neck pain, headache, numbness or tingling in the arms.
modify: Neck discomfort: shrug through a smaller range, lighter dumbbells.
Grip gives out first: use lifting straps or lighter dumbbells.
regressions: Standing dumbbell shrug with light dumbbells.
Shrug with empty hands, slow squeeze.

muscleNotes.upper_traps_r: Prime mover: lifts the shoulder blades; with the trunk inclined forward the arms hang ahead of the trunk, so the shrug also draws the shoulders back toward the spine.
muscleNotes.upper_traps_l: Prime mover: lifts the shoulder blades; with the trunk inclined forward the arms hang ahead of the trunk, so the shrug also draws the shoulders back toward the spine.
muscleNotes.rhomboids_midtrap_r: Hold the shoulder blades in against the ribs as they rise.
muscleNotes.rhomboids_midtrap_l: Hold the shoulder blades in against the ribs as they rise.
muscleNotes.serratus_r: Keeps the shoulder blades on the ribcage.
muscleNotes.serratus_l: Keeps the shoulder blades on the ribcage.
muscleNotes.core: Keeps the trunk still on the pad.

phases.label: Chest on the pad, arms hanging
